Thus the proof of the square-integrability and path-continuity parts of the theorem is invalid as written.

issues.failure_explanation: Shifting the variable so that U=F+G has its minimizer at 0 does not imply that G itself has a minimizer at 0. For example, in R, F(x)=1/2 x^2+x and G(x)=|x-1| give U(x)=F(x)+G(x) with minimizer at 0 while G is minimized at 1. Hence ∂G(0)=0 and the norm-reducing property of prox_{τG} are not justified under Ass F_G.
